login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your fleet, bookings and customers.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Set up your rental company on Veltrio.

legal.notice: By continuing, you agree to Veltrio's <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

onboarding.title: Set up your company
onboarding.subtitle: A few details and your portal is ready.
onboarding.subdomainHelp: Where renters see your fleet and book. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.subdomainHelpSaved: Where renters see your fleet and book. Links you've already shared stop working if you change it.

noTenant.title: No company access
noTenant.description: Your account is not a member of any company. Ask an owner to invite you.

invite.title: Join {{company}}
invite.subtitle: You've been invited to join as {{role}}.
invite.invitedEmail: This invitation is for {{email}}. Sign in or sign up with that address to accept it.
invite.chooseSubtitle: Choose the company to join. An account belongs to one company at a time.

wrongAccount.title: Signed in with a different email
wrongAccount.description: This invitation is for {{invited}}, but you're signed in as {{current}}. Sign out, then sign in with {{invited}}.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Ask someone at {{company}} to send you a new one.

notFound.title: This invitation link doesn't work
notFound.description: It may have been revoked, used already, or replaced by a newer one. Ask the company to send you a new invitation.

alreadyMember.title: You already belong to a company
alreadyMember.description: An account belongs to one company at a time. To join another, ask an owner of your current company to remove you, or sign in with a different email.

none.title: No invitations for this account
none.description: Nobody has invited this email address yet. Ask an owner to invite you, or set up your own company.

errors.addressTooLong: Keep the address to 160 characters or fewer
errors.subdomainInvalid: Use 3-63 lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, not at the start or end
errors.subdomainReserved: This URL is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.subdomainTaken: Another company has this URL. Choose another one.
errors.countryRequired: Select the country you operate in
errors.fleetSizeRequired: Select how many vehicles you operate
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

planStep.title: Choose your plan
planStep.subtitleTrial_one: Every plan starts with a {{count}}-day free trial. Your card is charged only when it ends.
planStep.subtitleTrial_other: Every plan starts with a {{count}}-day free trial. Your card is charged only when it ends.
planStep.subtitle: Plans are sized by your fleet. You can change plan at any time.

readyStep.title: You're all set
readyStep.subtitle: {{company}} is ready on Veltrio. A few things to set up first:

plan.none: No plan yet: bookings and renter checks start once you choose one.

dashboard.title: Your whole counter, on one screen
dashboard.body: Today's pickups, returns and unpaid balances, the moment you sign in.

site.title: Your own booking website
site.body: Renters book and pay on your site, under your name and colours, with no commission.

calendar.title: Every car and booking on one calendar
calendar.body: See who has which car, when it comes back, and what is free to rent.

booking.title: Ready before the keys go out
booking.body: Agreement signed, licence and insurance checked, deposit held: all on the booking.

company.title: Your booking site, at your own URL
company.body: Renters browse your fleet, pick their dates and book, under your name and colours.

plan.title: Your fleet, calendar and renter checks
plan.body: Every car, every booking and every background, ID and insurance check, in one place.

ready.title: Ready before the keys go out
ready.body: Renters sign and pay from a link you send, and you see it all on the booking.
